pages.lines:
July 28, 2024
This was a great place to stop overnight on our way to Florida. The woman at the front desk was very friendly and nice, and the sites are nestled between rows of trees. Our site was relatively flat so we didn’t have to disconnect. The reason for only three stars is there is much of the Campground that is old and definitely in need of upgrading / refurbishing. Our electric box did not have a breaker and honestly looked in terrible condition. (I was glad that I had a surge protector!) However, I did not have any issues with the electric. The bathroom was also old and much in need of refurbishing. The dump station was so bad we had to use an empty campsite to dump. It had rained and the pipe at the regular dump site was literally at the bottom of a pond. Having said all that, we might stop there again as the price was reasonable ($35 for water/30amp) and it was literally right off the highway, so very convenient for a quick overnight.
Terry T
May 02, 2024
Not sure why anyone would leave a negative review, this is a great place for folks passing thru. Clean sites with full hookup for $44 a night is a sweet deal. This place is huge and sites are pull thru and can accommodate big rigs. Nice dog park that you can tell used to be a putt putt course ages ago. Booking was a breeze, i called 2 hours before arrival, paid when we got there, easiest check in ever, literally took 2 minutes. Very conveniently located right off the interstate and cracker barrel is across the street. What more can you ask for?
